UPSSSC Assistant Store Keeper Grade Final Result 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Board (UPSSSC) has released the Final Result for the post of Assistant Store Keeper under the Advt No. : 02-Exam/2024. This recruitment was released for 200 posts. The applications for UPSSSC Assistant Store Keeper Grade III Recruitment 2024 were accepted from 15 February 2024 to 06 March 2024. The typing test examination was conducted on 18 December 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPSSSC Assistant Store Keeper Grade III Final Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 February 2024
  • Last Date : 06 March 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 March 2024
  • Correction Last Date : 13 March 2024
  • Eligibility Result Available : 13 February 2025
  • Exam Date : 13 April 2025
  • Exam City Details : 03 April 2025
  • Admit Card : 09 April 2025
  • Answer Key : 15 April 2025
  • Result : 29 October 2025
  • Typing Test Exam Date : 18 December 2025
  • Typing Test Admit Card : 10 December 2025
  • Typing Test Result : 25 February 2026
  • Final Result : 25 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 25/-
  • PH (Dviyang) : Rs. 25/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
